highlights.title: Agents speak your language
highlights.line: On a Mac set to another language, a new agent now starts and posts in that language instead of English.

highlights.title: See what your agent asks
highlights.line: When Claude Code asks an agent whether to switch models, its page shows the question, not "cannot find the question".

highlights.title: Agents report Kosmos bugs
highlights.line: Agents can post a Kosmos bug report to the Kosmos+ community and are told to leave out your files, logs and screens.
